description: Send a transactional email via your AWS SES account. Requires WRAPS_WRITE_ENABLED=true. The `from` address must be a verified SES identity (an address or domain) in this account and region. The `to` field accepts a single address or an array of addresses.

from.description: Sender address. Must be a verified SES identity in this account. Defaults to WRAPS_FROM_EMAIL.

html.description: HTML body. Provide `html`, `text`, or both; at least one is required.

text.description: Plain-text body. Provide `html`, `text`, or both; at least one is required.

to.description: Recipient address, or an array of up to 1000 addresses.

name: send_email

messageId.description: SES message id; pass to get_email_event_log for delivery events.

to.description: Recipients the message was accepted for.
